answer.rationale: Roll out the confirmed shorter onboarding flow across self-serve accounts: it improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%. Avoid promotional pricing despite the competitive pressure because the verified discounted cohort suffered a 12% retention decline, undermining sustainable qualified revenue. Onboarding is not proven to prevent competitor-driven churn among existing SMBs, so that limitation remains explicit.
